title: Informed Options Trading Prior to Takeover Announcements: Insider Trading?
authors: Patrick Augustin; Menachem Brenner; Marti G. Subrahmanyam
eligible_reason: Financial event study of abnormal options and stock trading volume and returns before M&A announcements (one event per deal), plus deal-level cross-sectional regressions. No staggered DiD, no unit and calendar-time FE panel. Package ships only a deal-level spreadsheet and data description, no code.
design_notes: Package: MS_DATA_ABS2018.xls (1,859 deals: SDC characteristics, premia, news and 13D indicators, indicators of abnormal options/stock volume), DATA-DESCRIPTION-ABS2018.txt, Online-Appendix.pdf. No regression code (empty inventory).
data_files_note: Deal-level derived variables only; daily OptionMetrics/CRSP data needed for the main event studies are licensed and not shipped.
data_provenance_note: Only deal-level summary indicators shipped; underlying options/stock data not shipped; no code.
